description: If \(\varphi(\bar x)\models\psi(\bar x)\) in every assignment, there is an interpolating formula in the same finite free-name context whose nonlogical symbol support is contained in the intersection of the two original supports.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CraigInterpolation.formula_interpolation.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {n : ℕ}
  (φ ψ : L.Formula (Fin n))
  (h : ∀ (M : Type (max u v)) [inst : L.Structure M] [Nonempty M] (a : Fin n → M), φ.Realize a → ψ.Realize a) :
  ∃ θ,
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ChangingLanguages.formulaSymbols θ ⊆
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ChangingLanguages.formulaSymbols φ ∩
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ChangingLanguages.formulaSymbols ψ ∧
      (∀ (M : Type (max u v)) [inst : L.Structure M] [Nonempty M] (a : Fin n → M), φ.Realize a → θ.Realize a) ∧
        ∀ (M : Type (max u v)) [inst : L.Structure M] [Nonempty M] (a : Fin n → M), θ.Realize a → ψ.Realize a
